evidence.exportsMap: No ./grid, ./grid-list or ./data-grid subpath anywhere in the 80-entry exports map (a `./grid*` entry would sort between ./form line 301 and ./input line 315; the map goes form -> input).
evidence.shared: see the shared evidence block: no Grid/DataGrid page in the docs index or bundled docs; no CHANGELOG/release-note entry.
evidence.partialCapability: internals/composite/root/gridNavigation.d.ts exports gridNavigation({ cols, dense?, itemSizes? }) -> CompositeGridNavigator with 2D arrow navigation keyed by rows/cols, rtl-aware, disabledIndices-aware, and loopFocus-aware. It is an internal hook used by Base UI's own popups in grid mode (see the v1.8.0 note 'Render groups with the rowgroup role in grid mode' for Autocomplete/Combobox). It provides navigation only — no selection, no virtualization, no column/header semantics — so it is not a migration target for a DataGrid.

consequence: NO_BASE_UI_EQUIVALENT. Any grid/table widget must remain on react-aria-components or another library. Do not build a DataGrid on internals/composite: it is undocumented, unversioned-by-contract, and lacks selection/sorting/virtualization.
notableDifferences: React Aria's GridList/Table provides a collection with selection, keyboard navigation across cells/rows, and (via @internationalized/date and react-stately) virtualized/scrolling data; Base UI exposes only gridNavigation for popup item navigation.
Base UI's listbox/popup components (Select, Combobox, Autocomplete) do support grid mode internally, so a *menu-like* 2D layout is achievable inside those components only — not as a standalone grid.
